title: Add regression tests for GoalRepositoryImpl's not-found and delete-sync payload paths
rule: EH-2 (typed exceptions surfaced correctly) / TQ-8 (every reachable error branch needs a red-first test)

evidence.quote:
if (existing == null) {
        throw ArgumentError('Goal not found: $goalId');

priority: DailyTaskPriority.values.firstWhere(
        (p) => p.name == row.priority,
        orElse: () => DailyTaskPriority.newLearning,

static DayType fromStorageKey(String key) =>
      DayType.values.firstWhere((e) => e.storageKey == key);

why: (a) updateGoal throws ArgumentError when goalId doesn't exist (e.g. the goal was deleted from another device and the sync merge already removed the local row before this device's in-flight edit lands) — no test in this file ever calls updateGoal with a nonexistent id, so nothing pins whether it throws, what it throws, or that a future refactor doesn't silently swallow/change it. (b) The file's own 'sync payload completeness (R4-6)' group exists specifically because create/update once shipped without profile_id/id in the outbox payload — but that hardening was never extended to deleteGoal: _RecordingGoalSyncFacade.deleteGoal is a blind no-op with no payload recorder (unlike goalPayloads for pushGoal), and the sole 'deleteGoal removes the goal' test uses the sync-less `repo` instance, so _syncDeleteGoal's {firestore_id, curriculum_id} payload is completely unverified. A key rename or dropped field in _syncDeleteGoal would ship silently — the exact class of bug R4-6 was written to catch for create/update.
recommendation: Add a test asserting updateGoal(goalId: <nonexistent>) throws ArgumentError; add a deletePayloads recorder to _RecordingGoalSyncFacade and a test asserting deleteGoal() pushes the expected firestore_id/curriculum_id payload, mirroring the existing R4-6 create/update tests.
acceptance_criteria: New red-first test fails against a deliberately-broken updateGoal (e.g. the null check removed) and passes against current code.
New deleteGoal-payload test fails if _syncDeleteGoal's field names are renamed or dropped, mirroring the existing R4-6 create/update tests.

corrections: Rule tags (EH-2/TQ-8) are a loose fit — TQ-8 is framed for bug-fix regressions and EH-2 for exception-conversion, neither exactly matches 'missing coverage for an existing branch' — but this doesn't undermine the underlying, well-evidenced coverage gap.
none — evidence and reasoning verified accurate as stated.

mergedFrom: Guard the remaining bare CurriculumId/DayType.firstWhere enum lookups with the same orElse fallback used elsewhere in these same files
